title: When AI agents slip the leash: How companies monitor and control them
description: As AI agents gain more autonomy, companies are struggling to see when they cross the limits set for them. The challenge is not only detecting rogue behaviour, but stopping it in time.

title: AI investment boom supports markets, but slowdown could trigger sharp repricing: RBI Governor Malhotra
description: Malhotra said a correction in AI-related valuations in advanced economies could, however, have a positive spillover for emerging markets such as India through higher capital inflows.

title: Global debt, AI risks among 5 financial stability threats, says RBI Governor Malhotra
description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra flagged global debt, stressed asset valuations, high leverage, private credit and AI-driven cyber risks as key vulnerabilities.

title: Apple to tighten Full Disk Access on Mac after AI agent concerns over user data
description: The move followed reports that some agentic apps can read broad swathes of local data.
